$345,000, 5 bed, 3.00 bath, 1,928 SF, MLS# 604434

Looking for a big home for your family? This beautiful home in Clayton Ranch is designed for a growing family!
With 5BR or 4BR and flex room, 3BA, and an open living area, this just may be your next home. Hosting family and friends' events will be effortless here with the open floor plan and large living area. ((Not to mention the enormous playscape in the yard for the children to play.) Prepare your favorite meals in the gorgeous kitchen that boasts a huge pantry and breakfast bar. The master bedroom and retreat takes relaxing to a new level, with a large soaking tub and shower! This home was built in 2023 and still looks brand new. Priced under the county appraisal price, this home will certainly be appealing not only for looks, but for the the price as well.  Only minutes from the bypass to HEB and Ft Hood, will make traveling to work and shopping easier.
Call your favorite agent today to see this beauty.

3 full bath
